verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a terminal coding agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out: the llms.txt probe only says a data-handling policy exists, and the usage-window and plan views are billing features, not opt-out controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
